articles.title: Welcome to AlumniZone
articles.body:
AlumniZone is the private, invite-only network for graduates of the Institute.

Use the Wall to share updates, Groups for your batch or city, Events for reunions, and Forums for longer discussions.

articles.title: Completing your profile
articles.body:
Add your batch, department, city and current role so classmates can find you.

Your career history helps students find mentors.

articles.title: Code of conduct

Be kind. Be respectful of privacy. No unsolicited sales pitches.

townhalls.title: AMA with the Director
townhalls.description: Ask the Institute Director anything about campus plans, research and alumni partnerships.

townhalls.title: Placement season Q&A
townhalls.description: Alumni recruiters answer student and alumni questions about hiring this year.

townhalls.title: Campus 2030 plan
townhalls.description: The alumni association walked through the 2030 campus master plan.

townhallQuestions.text: Will alumni get access to the new incubation centre?
How is the endowment fund being used?
Any plans for a part-time master’s for working alumni?
Do referrals from alumni actually make a difference?
townhallQuestions.answer: Yes. Referred candidates are three times more likely to reach the final round.

townhallQuestions.text: Is it OK to negotiate a campus offer?
Will the new hostels be walkable from the academic blocks?
townhallQuestions.answer: Yes. Every hostel is planned within a ten-minute walk of the academic core, with covered walkways.

townhallQuestions.text: How can alumni contribute to the new labs?
townhallQuestions.answer: Through named lab sponsorships and by mentoring student research teams. Details will be shared in the Alumni Handbook.

townhallQuestions.text: What is the timeline for the library expansion?
townhallQuestions.answer: Phase one opens next year. Phase two depends on fundraising.
